title: APT Knowledge Contracts
source: Extracted from applied-practical-thinking knowledge engine material

properties.id: Stable identifier for retrieval and citation.
properties.title: Human-readable title.
properties.audience: human, agent, public, internal, or mixed.
properties.confidence: low, medium, or high when generated or retrieved.

properties.fallback: Optional deterministic fallback when retrieval or provider behavior is degraded.

properties.source: Incident, support ticket, release, validation run, or user feedback source.
properties.disposition: doc_update, test_update, runbook_update, ux_fix, decision_record, or non_action.
properties.owner: Person or team responsible for closure.
properties.evidence: Validation or review evidence for the disposition.

rules: Knowledge retrieval must cite canonical or project-owned sources.
AI-facing knowledge must preserve source priority and status.
Feedback should become either a doc update, a test update, a runbook update, a UX fix, a decision record, or an explicit non-action.
Sensitive knowledge must define visibility, redaction, retention, and escalation before ingestion.
Incident and support learning should link back to validation or release evidence when available.
